summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/blank. Core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, not in sub-tasks but also called validateApp and would have broken) now pass owner. Single PR #1 since shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build, so no version bump/registry release was needed. Assumption: owner values hardcoded to match each package.json 'team' (bundler can't import JSON). Reports isn't deployed by CD (only shell/billing are).
